features: Reliable USB 2.0 Performance – Delivers read speeds up to 30 MB/s, suitable for everyday file storage and sharing at work, school, and home.
Wide Capacity Options – Available in multiple storage sizes from 8GB to 512GB, letting you choose the right capacity for documents, media, and backups.
Plug & Play Convenience – USB 2.0 interface supports plug-and-play operation with no drivers or external power required.
Durable ABS Shell Design – Built with an ABS body that offers drop resistance along with water-proof and dust-proof protection.
Broad Device Compatibility – Works with PCs, Macs, tablets, mobile phones, smart TVs, car audio systems, and sound equipment.
